item.title: Version 1.3.93
item.description:
- GlassCard panels, glass buttons, glow (primary) buttons and the sidebar panel now use the neon-glass look: frosted body with a bright top edge, deeper shadow and a rim of light in the photo accent color. Every screen (Galleries, Publish, Settings, Web Import, Resize, Updates, Extras, Site Organizer) picks it up from the shared components.
- Decorative green icons and progress tints now follow the photo accent; success states and status chips keep their green.
- The accent is provided app-wide through the SwiftUI environment (neonAccent) and .tint.
